title: TravelAgency load test (k6)
description: k6 results (Prometheus remote write) next to CPU, Tomcat, JVM heap and MySQL

panels.title: Virtual users
panels.description: Users the test simulates right now

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Share of failed HTTP requests over the last minute. Goal: < 1%

panels.title: p95 response time
panels.description: 95% of requests are faster than this. Goal: < 1.5 s

panels.title: Bookings made
panels.description: Successful bookings since the test started

panels.title: Checks passed
panels.description: Share of k6 checks (right redirect, rooms found, ...) that passed. Goal: > 99%

panels.title: Response time p95 by step
panels.description: login / search / book / browse / logout. The dashed line is the number of users

panels.title: Requests/s and errors/s
panels.description: Throughput. If users go up and requests/s stays flat, the system is saturated

panels.title: Response time p50 / p95 / p99 (all requests)
Bookings per second
panels.description: Business result: full login -> search -> book journeys

panels.title: Servers at the same time (CPU, Tomcat, JVM)
CPU used per server (Proxmox)
panels.description: The server that hits 80-100% first is the bottleneck

panels.title: Busy Tomcat threads
panels.description: Busy threads near max = requests wait in the queue

panels.title: Heap used
panels.description: Saw-tooth is normal. A floor that keeps rising = memory leak

panels.title: GC time per second
panels.description: More than 0.1 s per second = JVM spends >10% of time on garbage collection

panels.title: Tomcat requests/s per node
panels.description: Should be about equal: nginx round-robin

panels.title: MySQL connections
panels.description: running queries close to CPU cores of vm-db = MySQL is busy

panels.title: New MySQL connections per second
panels.description: The app has no connection pool (DriverManagerDataSource): every DB access opens a new connection. High numbers here = pool needed

panels.title: Redis commands per second
panels.description: Every request reads/writes the HTTP session in Redis

panels.title: Load average (1 min)
panels.description: Above the number of CPU cores = processes wait for CPU
